sources.title: JoyBoyuuu/TCFM-Flow-SLM-1B-Extended · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TCFM Flow-SLM 1B-Extended Adapters This repository contains the three formally evaluated Temporal-Coupled Flow Matching (TCFM) FlowHead adapters for speech continuation. TCFM preserves the Flow-SLM sampler, Mimi codec, Transformer, and semantic pathway. It fine-tunes only 488,448 LoRA parameters in the FlowHead by adding speech-time endpoint-trajectory supervision to conditional flow matching.
